label: No placebo
rationale: This is a randomized parallel study comparing two MPC-encapsulated NGF treatment arms against an active NGF control, not an inactive placebo. The control group receives NGF 60ml, and the arms are explicitly listed as experimental versus active comparator, so the design supports no placebo comparator.
